name: What occurs during a felony preliminary hearing?

mainEntity.name: What occurs during a felony preliminary hearing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The judge reviews prosecution evidence to decide if there is probable cause to proceed to trial. Your attorney can cross-examine witnesses and challenge evidence during this hearing.sandiegocriminalattorneys+1​
